about: The frames requests of the WP0 'before' run (docs/public-site/before-numbers.md, Nov 11, sampler preview, three minutes per playing session): Origin is every request (refusals included) the Worker would answer. Bytes per session were not split by host there, so frames_bytes is left 0; cost.py prices bytes at zero anyway. Replace with --harness on the real logs when they are copied over. static_requests = Requests - Origin - CDN.
